title: Most Friendly
citation: Presented to Abdulkareem Abdulrazak in deep appreciation of your exceptional warmth, kindness and accommodating spirit. You have been a true friend to all, with an open heart that welcomes everyone and a character that makes our class feel like family. Your friendliness will be remembered long after we leave these walls.

title: Most Punctual Student
citation: Presented to Haruna Momodu in recognition of your outstanding discipline and unwavering commitment to punctuality. You have consistently demonstrated the value of time and set a remarkable example of responsibility and dedication. Your consistency is a virtue worthy of emulation.

title: Most Innovative Student
citation: Presented to Usman Shehu Ahmad in recognition of your exceptional creativity, brilliant ideas and innovative mindset. You have consistently inspired us with your ability to think differently, solve problems creatively and bring fresh perspectives that have enriched our class.

title: Best Dressed Student
citation: Presented to Ramatu Sanusi in recognition of your outstanding elegance, graceful appearance and impeccable sense of style. You carry yourself with class and dignity, and your refined fashion sense has been a mark of excellence and pride to our set.

title: Most Handsome Student
citation: Presented to Abubakar Imrana in recognition of your outstanding personality, charm and distinguished presence. Your confidence, decency and charisma have made you a gentleman of exceptional repute among your peers.

title: Most Beautiful
citation: Presented to Aisha Nuhu in recognition of your exceptional beauty, grace and radiant personality. Your elegance goes beyond outward appearance, reflecting inner beauty, composure and a spirit that brightens our class.

title: Most Reserved
citation: Presented to Aisha Nuhu in recognition of your calm, composed and dignified disposition. Your quiet strength, maturity and respectful demeanour have earned you the admiration of all and stand as a model of true character.

title: Best Entrepreneur
citation: Presented to Muhammed Fatimat Onozasi in recognition of your outstanding entrepreneurial drive, vision and business acumen. You have demonstrated that academic excellence and enterprise can go together, inspiring many with your determination to create value.

title: Class Comedian
citation: Presented to Abolarin Jeremiah Adedayo in recognition of your wonderful sense of humour and your invaluable role in keeping the class joyful. Through your wit and light-heartedness, you have turned difficult moments into laughter and strengthened our unity.

title: Most Social Student
citation: Presented to Jumah Abdulmojeed Enitan in recognition of your outstanding sociability, approachability and exceptional ability to connect with everyone. You have been the bridge that unites us all and your selfless availability has been a gift to the class.

title: Class Representative
citation: In recognition of your pioneering leadership and meritorious service as the first substantive Class Representative of this set. You laid a solid foundation with dedication, sacrifice and vision during our formative years. Your legacy of service remains indelible.

title: Class Representative
citation: In recognition of your exemplary leadership, uncommon dedication and steadfast commitment as Class Representative. For over three years, you led with integrity, patience and selflessness, steering the affairs of the class with wisdom and ensuring no one was left behind.

title: Class Representative
citation: In recognition of your dedicated and committed service as Class Representative. Your willingness to serve, your sense of responsibility and your contributions to the progress of this class are deeply appreciated and highly commendable.

title: Assistant Class Representative
citation: In recognition of your loyal, diligent and committed service as Assistant Class Representative. You stood firmly as a pillar of support, demonstrating reliability, humility and a genuine passion for the welfare of the class.

title: Exceptional Services
citation: In recognition of your exceptional and tireless service to the class. Always available, always willing, you have given your time, energy and resources selflessly for the good of all. Your service is truly exceptional.

title: Selfless Dedication
citation: In recognition of your selfless dedication and invaluable contributions to the class. You have served without seeking reward, showing true commitment and a heart of service that has positively impacted every member of this set.

title: Meritorious Academic Contribution
citation: In recognition of your meritorious academic contribution and intellectual support to the class. Through your willingness to share knowledge, tutor colleagues and uplift others academically, you have left a lasting mark of excellence and brotherhood.

title: Exceptional Service
citation: In recognition of your exceptional service and unwavering commitment to the class. Your quiet yet impactful contributions, your reliability and your dedication to duty have not gone unnoticed. We are truly grateful for your service.
